item.description: ### Added - **Perch now sees Antigravity CLI sessions — live.** Google's `agy` shows up in the fleet like every other agent: running, waiting on a permission prompt or a question, finished, or idle, with the folder, model and context usage. Perch registers itself as the CLI's status line (stacked under the CLI's own, or chained ahead of one you already had) and adds one `Stop` hook, both pointing at the bundled `agy-report`; both are removed by Remove Integration and the uninstall script. Finishing a turn plays the completion sound and sends the "finished" notification; pressing Escape does not. Sessions started before Perch installed the integration are found by scanning the CLI's own records (newest conversation per folder). - **Antigravity's weekly quota, as usage bars.** The CLI reports how much of each weekly limit is left — one for Gemini models, one for Claude and GPT — on every status-line refresh. Perch shows the tighter one as the headline bar with the other beneath it, with the plan tier, the reset time, and the usual running-low warning — on the Mac now, and on phone, watch and widget once the companion app is updated. No account login is stored: only a fingerprint, so a switched login is noticed. - Not yet for Antigravity: Stats, and typing into the session from the phone. Phone and watch need the matching companion update to show the new rows.
